description: Measured Kaspa throughput from api.kaspa.org: blocks per second over the last ~600 blue scores (DAA score delta / time delta between two chain blocks), estimated transactions per second (average transactions per block in a recent-block sample x measured BPS), and DAG width (parallel blocks per blue score, average merge set size) from that sample. Both windows are returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_kaspa_chain_density when you need ratio of selected-chain blocks to total DAG blocks created; crypto_kaspa_recent_blocks when you need the most recent Kaspa blocks: hash, block timestamp, blue. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_kaspa_throughput
title: Measured Kaspa throughput from api.kaspa.org: blocks per
